textbook_summary: Broad abnormal QRS; faster ventricular rhythm with slower independent P and no fixed PR.

authored_choices.contour: Reuse authored ventricular escape QRS and discordant T coefficients; shorter T/QT support for established VT

limitations: Fixed monomorphic160bpm example, not traced ventricular focus or clinical QT calibration
Optional fusion illustration documented in vt-fusion.json; capture is documented in vt-capture.json; onset/termination, polymorphic VT and TdP remain open
Both demos integrated; bounded per-beat filling perfusion documented in vt-perfusion.json
PR placeholder is hidden; true independent source clocks determine P/QRS timing
